Metadata.Goal: Independently verify G01-G14 observable capability parity across Bun and .NET OM.
Metadata.Description: Run both runtimes, audit every evidence row, and produce archive-ready mission closure evidence.

TaskSpace.name: verify-dotnet-om-bun-capability-parity
TaskSpace.Description: Build the evidence contract, execute both runtimes, and audit mission closure.

TaskGroup.name: Build evidence contract
TaskGroup.Description: Map G01-G14 to implementation tracks, tests, and frozen decisions.

Task.name: Create G01-G14 evidence inventory
Task.Description: Resolve each gap to Bun/.NET source, paired tests, linked track reports, and decisions.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Every G01-G14 item has desired, actual, test, decision, and evidence fields.

Task.name: Close missing paired verification cases
Task.Description: Add only missing tests or decision-free fixes required to make every shared contract executable.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: No evidence row relies solely on prose when executable behavior is available.

TaskGroup.name: Execute cross-runtime gates
TaskGroup.Description: Run Bun, .NET, focused parity, and Codument validation gates.

Task.name: Run Bun OM verification
Task.Description: Run the Bun full suite and focused governance/behavior/schema/existential/public cases.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Bun full and focused suites pass with recorded counts.

Task.name: Run .NET OM verification
Task.Description: Build and run the .NET full OM harness plus focused parity fixtures and optional-package contracts.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: .NET build, full harness, focused fixtures, portability, YAML, and Jint contracts pass.

Task.name: Validate linked Codument controls
Task.Description: Resolve every bound TrackLink and run strict/XML validation over linked tracks.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: All bound tracks exist, are completed, and pass structural validation.

TaskGroup.name: Audit and publish closure evidence
TaskGroup.Description: Independently judge every row and publish archive-ready mission evidence.

Task.name: Publish final G01-G14 matrix
Task.Description: Produce issues-first final evidence with explicit intentional differences and residual risk.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: All fourteen rows have fresh evidence and PASS, or the track is BLOCKED with a precise gap.

Task.name: Verify archive readiness
Task.Description: Run final source, test, XML, strict, report-consistency, and working-tree boundary checks.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: The verification track and mission evidence are internally consistent and archive-ready.
